notes: Universal companion AI 0.8.5. Narrow 300x385 panel with ability scores split over two lines. Adds a persistent vertical NUI strip beside the party portraits showing up to 6 unique ongoing non-hostile spell effects on the selected companion using each spell's spells.2da IconResRef and hover tooltip. Weapon telemetry now shows both hands. Tactical offhand handling: companions with Two-Weapon Fighting/Ambidexterity can auto-equip the best compatible offhand melee weapon in normal pressure; shield proficiency is preferred under heavy pressure (3+ close enemies), <=40% HP, or defensive/protect modes. Manually equipped offhand weapons are not replaced in ordinary situations unless tactical shield danger requires it. Arcane companions still avoid shield spell failure except in real danger. Preserves 0.8.4 spell/prebuff fixes and 0.8.3 autoheal.
